hero.name: Layla Rodas

hero.lead: Backend Developer specialized in business automation, ERP integrations and reliable backend systems.
hero.description: I build backend systems and automation solutions for real business workflows, including ERP integrations, document processing, authenticated web automation and data-driven applications.

about.title: About Me
about.p1: I build software that connects systems and automates everyday business work — from invoice processing and accounting exports to dashboards that teams actually use.
about.p2: Most of my recent work sits at the intersection of backend engineering and operational data: integrating ERPs, validating business records, and making sure information moves reliably between tools.
about.p3: I care about writing clear, dependable code for real processes, not demos. Python, Java, PHP, SQL and REST APIs are my day-to-day tools; Power BI when the goal is insight.
